title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Training Note: Shingle Matching on Older Asphalt Roofs
content:
*Training note for the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claims desk: questions answered on the matching allowance.*

**The rule.** When wind or hail roof surfacing damage on a HomeGuard claim is re-settled from a below-deductible denial, a matching allowance is added so that the repaired roof presents a reasonably uniform appearance. Shingle lines on an older asphalt roof are no longer made, so undamaged adjoining slopes must be replaced with the damaged ones. The allowance is 10 percent of the roof surfacing's replacement-cost value for an asphalt roof at least 20 years old at the date of loss, and 5 percent for an asphalt roof 10 to 19 years old. No allowance applies to a younger asphalt roof, whose shingles are still available, or to a roof of any other material.

**Which roofs count as asphalt?** Three-tab and architectural asphalt, as the roof material is shown on the declarations. Wood shake, tile/slate and metal roofs take no matching allowance at any age.

**How is the roof's age measured?** As at the date of loss, in whole years from the roof install year on the declarations: the calendar year of the date of loss minus the roof install year.

**Where do the bands meet?**

| Asphalt roof age at the date of loss | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 20 years or more | 10 percent |
| 10 to 19 years | 5 percent |
| Under 10 years | None |

A roof aged exactly 20 takes 10 percent; at 19 it takes 5 percent. A roof aged exactly 10 takes 5 percent; at 9 it takes none.

**On what figure is the percentage taken, and where does it go?** On the replacement-cost value recorded on the roof surfacing's below-deductible denial entry. The allowance is added to the reversal payment before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

**Worked case (hypothetical figures).** An architectural asphalt roof installed in 2002, hail loss in 2024: age 22, so 10 percent. On a roof surfacing replacement-cost value of 14000.00 the allowance is 1400.00. Had the roof been installed in 2012 (age 12), the allowance would be 5 percent, 700.00. A metal roof of the same age and value takes none.
